content: Mass rename failure modes: substring collisions (a brand token that is a substring of an unrelated identifier, or a replacement token that contains a reserved word), case-variant drift (lower/Pascal/UPPER each need their own pass and each can be missed independently), filename-vs-content desync (git mv without updating build manifests that reference paths), binary/asset files invisible to text grep, and generated/committed artifacts that keep the old value. Verification must be an exhaustive residual scan with an explicit allowlist of legitimate remaining occurrences, not a spot check.
